newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian firm offers chance to see comet from jet.
newsitem.headline: Belgian firm offers chance to see comet from jet.

text.p: Beat the clouds and spoil your best friends or clients with champagne, canapes and caviar while giving them a close look of a shooting star aboard a jet.

Belgian public relations firm Brainware said on Friday it was offering an exclusive close-up of the Hale-Bopp comet at over 30,000 feet for those ready to pay 5,500 francs ($190) for a one-hour night ride on a Boeing 373 jetliner.

Astronomers call the comet, discovered in July 1995 and on clear nights visible in the early evening in the northwest, one of the astrological events of the year. Experts will join the flights to explain the phenomenon to passengers.
